formulaBlock.normalization: No split synonym entries; 'Maris Sal (Dead Sea Salt)' one entry. E3: no Parfum -> first preservative Sodium Benzoate (8); prominent = 1-7.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: SLES (2) defining, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5); Laureth-9 is a nonionic ethoxylate, neither a route nor a buffer under C3; no reinforcing anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Only one buffer and no refatting oils; does not move C1.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful conditioning system: prominent cationic guar (7) with humectant Urea (6); no silicone, lipid or pearlizer.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Single light guar in a cleansing-led base could read as little substantive slip (low).

weightPotential.rationale: Single deposition family (one cationic guar at 7) facing an effective C1 reset; urea/glycerin are humectant context, not deposition.

persistence.rationale: light guar, no silicone/lipid to reinforce

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single light polymer facing moderate reset; no converging system.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate requires a plausibly persistent system or interacting routes; one guar with no second family is below that (no polymer floor).

nonionic_surfactant: ethoxylate, not a C3 cleansing route

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula pattern (Urea 6, Laureth-9/polidocanol 3, late menthol, Dead Sea salt) suggests a scalp-comfort role; needs SC1 positioning.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning hidden; CSA passes via prominent Urea (6, E4 comfort + humectant). Laureth-9 is the INCI name of Polidocanol (E4 comfort list) - recorded as mapping. Menthol/mint oil are not prominent.

careDirection.rationale: Urea/glycerin humectants but only one light conditioning route; reads as a scalp-comfort formula rather than a lengths moisture cluster.

formulaFacts.role: nonionic ethoxylate (INCI of polidocanol); not a C3 buffer; comfort-route candidate
